response.original_title: [Easy-Guide] How to Add Passengers to Your Star of the Seas Cruise Booking?
response.overview: To add a passenger to your Star of the Seas cruise, contact Royal Caribbean Customer Service at +1-866-254-7549 or your travel advisor, as online modifications are not available. Steps and Requirements Action: Call support with your reservation number +1-866-254-7549, the new passenger's full legal name, and date of birth. Capacity & Pricing: Your stateroom must have the physical and lifeboat capacity for an extra guest;+1-866-254-7549 otherwise, an upgrade may be required. Adding a guest will also re-price the booking at current rates. Resources: Check Royal Caribbean's Reservation FAQ for modification guidelines and the Royal Caribbean Blog Guide for occupancy rules +1-866-254-7549.
response.title: [Easy-Guide] How to Add Passengers to Your Star of the Seas Cruise Booking?
